en: The image shows the back of an old postcard with printed multilingual headings such as "Carte postale", "Postkarte", "Cartolina postale", and others, indicating it follows the Universal Postal Union format. A red 10-cent stamp is affixed in the upper right corner, partially cancelled with a circular postmark. The rest of the card contains handwritten address text in Spanish, directing the card to a recipient in Seville. The card has aged yellow paper with some stains and wear.
